decision.detail: I push my chair back. Stand. Pull my coat off the hook by the door. Walk out of the lobby. Two blocks, left on Main, the Rialto marquee is half-flickering. I go in. I find Alma. I set the reel-to-reel on the small table. I press record. I let her talk. I do not fill the silences. When she stops, I stop. I spool the tape. I put it in an envelope. I walk to the regional line depot and hand it to the courier. Then I walk to the bus station and board the coach for Pittsburgh.
decision.intention: Get Alma's voice on a reel before the Rialto's doors lock for the last time, so the regional line can carry it to Pittsburgh where her daughter is. Then be on the coach. Then be in the hallway with the couch. Do the two things in order. Do not skip either.
decision.words: "Give me ten minutes. I'll be back before the crew heads out."
